title: Conversation Summary v1
description: A deterministically-rebuilt digest of turns that have scrolled out of the recent-turn window — informative context only, never authoritative (CONV-GOV-016). Never LLM-generated; see compact_summary() and docs/bible/14-conversation/389-conversation-summary-model.md. Structured state (accepted JDL, DesignIntent, an open clarification, an active proposal) is never itself summarized away — only prose-level turn history is compacted here.
